verdicts.text: Spacelift's paid plans scale by private worker count rather than by seats or resources, with quote-based pricing at the top end.

Scalr (Sept 2026) says the paid tiers start at "Essentials $0.10, Standard $0.47, and Premium $0.99 per resource/month".

I didn't fetch the official HashiCorp page, which is why confidence is medium. One nuance: Scalr says paid plans bill every managed resource, while other sources describe the first 500 as a free allowance.

verdicts.framing_note: The sources say the self-managed Enterprise plan uses custom, sales-quoted pricing and is designed for large enterprises, which matches the claim. Public marketplace listings starting around $15k/yr don't contradict the "custom pricing" description.

verdicts.text: HCP Terraform beyond the free tier uses per-resource pricing of roughly $0.10 to $0.99 per resource per month depending on tier.
